Our story

Rooted in
nature.

Inspired by the elegance of the calathea leaf, our restaurant brings a sense of calm into the dining experience. From our green-and-gold identity to the plates leaving the kitchen, every detail is designed to feel warm, considered and memorable.

Come as you are. Stay for the food, the atmosphere and the people around your table.
